name: ANCContactDischarge
title: Antenatal care: end of contact (WHO SMART, pilot)
description: At the end of an antenatal care contact, checks the examination and laboratory results for pre-eclampsia and hypertension, gestational diabetes and anaemia, and says what to do: refer urgently, or counsel (with the iron and folic acid doses for anaemia). Source: WHO antenatal care recommendations (2016), Digital Adaptation Kit (2021), implemented with 3 unmodified WHO SMART ANC decision tables (CQL): ANC.DT.17 and ANC.DT.23 (WHO workflow step ANC.B10.4 Diagnosis and treatment), ANC.DT.25 (ANC.B9 Laboratory tests).
usage: Pilot. Evaluates the results of one ANC contact before it ends (encounter-discharge): the encounter is context.encounterId. Needs the Observations of that encounter, coded with the WHO ANC data dictionary codes or, through a curated binding, SNOMED CT; the ANC contact number is an Encounter extension. WHO SMART ANC IG 0.3.0 (continuous integration build, not a published release). The data come from the IG's Questionnaires ANC.B6 Profile (gestational age, chronic conditions), ANC.B8 Physical exam (blood pressure, pre-eclampsia symptoms, pallor) and ANC.B9 Lab tests (urine protein, glucose, haemoglobin).
